οἰνοκηκίς.definition: styptic made of oak-galls boiled in Gal.12.25

οἰνομανής.definition: mad for or after wine, Ath.11.464e

ὁμοδυναμέω.definition: to be of the same power, Paul.Al.E.1, Procl.Par.Ptol.39

ὀξυπόρος.definition: with pointed mouth, Opp.H.2.406; quick-passing, active, of medicines, Dsc.3.51

ὁδοφύλαξ.definition: watcher of the roads; = II, Eust.1445.20

ὀρνιθίας.definition: in pl., annual winds in; dealer in birds, Lib.Arg.D.19, Tz.H.6.56

ὄνοσμα.definition: stone bugloss, Onosma echinoides, Dsc.3.131, Gal.12.89, Plin.HN27.110

οἰωνίζομαι.definition: generally, divine from omens, c. acc. et inf., X.HG ll. cc., LXXGe.44.5

ὁμόκληρος.definition: Dor. having an equal share; esp. of an inheritance, coheir, Pi.O.2.49, N.9.5

οἰωνόθροος.definition: of the cry of birds, the wailing cry of birds, A.Ag.56

οἰακίζω.definition: Ion. steer: hence, govern, guide; metaph., Heraclit.64; Arist.EN1172a21:—Pass., D.S.18.59

ὁμόκλινος.definition: reclining on the same couch, at table, Hdt.9.16

οὐλόφυλλος.definition: with curling leaves, opp. of cabbage, Thphr.HP7.4.4

ὀνειδιστής.definition: one who reproaches with a thing, c. gen. rei, Arist.Rh.1381b2

ὀρθοκόρυδος.definition: a very lark, nickname of one with a thin bad voice, Alciphr.3.48

ὀξύκομος.definition: with pointed hair, of the porcupine, Opp.C.2.599; of a stag, ib.194; of a pine, App.Anth.5.46; with pointed spines, of a fish, Marc.Sid.21

ὀψίκοιτος.definition: going late to bed, late-watching, A.Ag.889

ὄσιρις.definition: poet's cassia, Osyris alba, Dsc.4.140 , Gal.12.93, Plin.HN27.111

ὁμοχροέω.definition: to be of the same colour, Gp.19.6.2, Aët.7.38

ὀδοντοφυής.definition: sprung from the dragon's teeth, of the Sparti, E.Ph.821

ὀνειροδότης.definition: giver of dreams, Perdrizet- Lefèbvre Les graffites grecs du Memnonion d' Abydos No.493:—fem. cj. for in Poet.de herb.42

ὀρσίπους.definition: raising the foot, swift-footed, AP15.27 ; stirring the feet to flight, Trag.Adesp.245

ὀψολόγος.definition: one who discourses on cookery, Ath.8.337b

οὐκ.definition: non: forma di οὐ davanti a vocale con spirito dolce (οὐχ davanti a spirito aspro)

οὐχ.definition: non: forma di οὐ davanti a vocale con spirito aspro

οὕτως.definition: così, in questo modo (οὕτω davanti a consonante); correlativo di ὥσπερ/ὡς

οἷος.definition: οἷος, -α, -ον: quale (relativo di qualità; correl. τοῖος/τοιοῦτος); οἷός τέ εἰμι + inf. = sono capace di

ὁμοκλέω.definition: gridare (insieme), minacciare, incitare con grida [epico] (ὁμοκλή: grido di comando)

οἰνοχοέω.definition: versare il vino, fare da coppiere (οἶνος + χέω): impf. epico οἰνοχόει/ᾠνοχόει

ὀδύσσομαι.definition: adirarsi, essere in collera [epico]: aor. ὠδυσάμην; nell'Odissea gioco etimologico col nome di Ὀδυσσεύς

οἰκτείρω.definition: compiangere, avere pietà di (+ acc.): aor. ᾤκτειρα (anche οἰκτίρω)
